basic_info.main_problem: I feel conflicted about my love of dance, liking it yet belittling its significance as a hobby; this conflict appeared about six months after I started full-time work, and repeatedly occurs when trying to make time for dance amid a busy work schedule.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to resolve these conflicting thoughts and regain her passion for dance.
growth_experiences: 六个月前开始全职Work后，Increased stress与时间紧张使我难以平衡兴趣与Work，逐渐对舞蹈的享受减少；我试图通过更多专注Work、减少舞蹈时间来“理性化”这种矛盾，结果导致与朋友的舞蹈活动减少、Interpersonal relationships受影响、日常Self-care declining。

core_beliefs: My worth depends on work output and efficiency
兴趣爱好（如舞蹈）not够“有用”，not值得投入太多时间

special_situations.event: Tries to schedule dance in a busy work timetable
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果把时间花在非职业相关的事情上，就是not负责任/浪费时间
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更专注于Work、减少或回避舞蹈活动以缓解Anxiety与内疚
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 跳舞not如Work有价值，我应该把时间用在更“有用”的事情上

special_situations.event: Recalls happy past experiences of dancing with friends or current positive feedback received
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面感受not代表其有价值，价值应以生产力与实用性衡量
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive experiences, further emphasizes work engagement to prove 'usefulness'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 尽管我喜欢跳舞，但这not算数/not重要

special_situations.event: 计划参加舞蹈课前，对可能影响Work的结果进行Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果继续跳舞，not yet来会更难平衡Work，从而影响表现
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Postpones or cancels dance plans to prevent possible negative consequences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Going to class may cause problems at work / make me lose control

special_situations.event: Weighing whether to do dance practice after work exhaustion
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能同时在Work和兴趣上做到完美，就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以全或without的标准选择完全not跳舞，以维持“负责”的自我形象
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 要么全力Worknot跳舞，要么跳舞就是not负责任

core_conflict.wish: 渴望Freedom地投入舞蹈，从中获得快乐与自我表达
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为not负责任与not够“有用”，从而失去对Work的掌控与稳定
defense_goal: 通过优先Work、为回避舞蹈找到合理理由来缓解内疚与Anxiety
Maintains a 'responsibility / productivity' image of self-demand to gain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A guilt-prone and self-demanding 'responsible one' who tends to measure self-worth by productivity
object_relations.object_representation: 支持但not知情的朋友群体（与舞蹈关联）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes joining a dance course or discusses how to balance work and hobbies
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to understand suggestions as needing to prove dancing is 'useful', worrying it will affect work responsibilities (transference: shifting the focus to productivity standards)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle, rational tone emphasizes 'work comes first', lists efficiency/output reasons, reduces emotional expression, and avoids having guilt further touched.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the joy dance brings or receiving positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将正面体验与价值切割，认为“喜欢not代表有用”，以理性标准Repression情绪
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use概念化、客观化的词汇讨论效益/产出，淡化情绪词，语气克制、冷静。

manifestations: 将舞蹈视为“not够有用”，贬低其意义
Takes productivity / practicality as the only criterion for measuring worth
outcomes: Interpersonal avoidance (reduced dance activities with friends)

manifestations: 在Freedom选择兴趣与社会责任（Work）之间感到拉扯
Bound by 'should/must' rules, hard to experience inner choice
outcomes: Lowered tolerance for experience; hard to stay self-consistent

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“应该/必须”来评价投入时间的价值
Uses 'work output' as the sole standard to belittle the meaning of dance

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 回避与朋友的舞蹈活动，Repression参与冲动
Turns energy to overtime or more focused work to relieve guilt
